title: Compose and publish Remix Protocol: Fast Dance-Punk variation
description: Compose and publish an aggressive 132 BPM dance-punk Big Beat variation of Remix Protocol using continuous 16th ride/open hats, skip kicks, walking bassline, and moving chord changes (i - bIII - IV - bVI).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Composed and auditioned Remix Protocol: Fast Dance-Punk variation (132 BPM, Am) with moving rave chord progression (Am -> C -> D -> F). Uses driving 4-on-the-floor style kick, 16th ride bell accents, continuous open-hat pulse, and walking bassline steps. Published to cloud storage as scr_scores_Remix Protocol: Dance-Punk_apr.

right_now_summary: The fast dance-punk variation was composed, auditioned, and published to cloud storage.
